scope: Read-only review of App, Setup, CameraPanel and JumpScare lifecycle; isolated SensorController mock reproduction.

mockReproduction.setup: Controller previously in Presage mode; mocked SDK stop waits on an explicitly released promise; mocked native availability returns unavailable without accessing hardware or a provider.

actions: start(manual, true) using current preference before SDK retirement completes

mockReproduction.interpretation: The previous resume call read the controller old mode while manual shutdown was pending. Resuming from current application preferences preserves the explicit stop request.

readOnlyVerifiedFixes: Mount-level visibility handler stops capture in setup, intro and gameplay, and removes its listener on unmount.
A run created while document.hidden starts paused and does not start capture.
Gameplay resume starts the current prefsRef sensing mode rather than the controller potentially retiring mode.
Camera-dialog Escape handling precedes the form-field keyboard guard.
Selected camera device is stored in App and passed to both setup and in-game CameraPanel instances.
Camera settings reject ended runs; starting a run and returning to menu reset cameraOpen.
Normal JumpScare timer cleanup and result-delay cleanup remain present across restart/unmount.
limitations: The isolated mock verifies asynchronous mode selection only; it does not establish webcam permission, physical track shutdown, native SDK processing or successful pulse capture.
The patch review was read-only. Browser and hardware verification are separate evidence.
This ad-hoc reproduction is not included in the automated test count.
